_readme: THE TERRAIN SHADOW'S INSTRUMENT (Globe.hlsl TerrainRay; scene render.shadowSteps, shadowRangeM): the
Sawatch Range of Colorado from 40 km, looking north along the Arkansas valley in the late afternoon, the sun
low in the west, so every ridge throws its shadow east across the next valley. The relief is ETOPO 2022 at
15 arcseconds (about 450 m a texel), which is what the planet carries everywhere; the shadows are what that
field can cast. The planet's buildings are off: the picture is the ground alone.
... --set render.shadowSteps=0        the same instant without the shadow
The instant is fixed, so a still repeats (--scale 0 --settle-exact).
